claims.summary: The release is grounded in the fresh deployed v0.15.103 UX ZIP/log audit, which exported Quality 99 and Texture 95 but retained a clinical-methods source P1.
The current local regrade intentionally scores the same v0.15.103 artifact at 97/A because two trusted source-ledger rows are wrong-field review false friends.
UX source trust no longer treats bare review as a valid source anchor and keeps only design/studio-specific review anchors.
Source-finder rejects the health-gamification systematic-review shape for UX critique topics before it reaches cached source mini-shards.
The deep quality grader mirror flags any exported health-gamification review linked to UX critique concepts as off-discipline source proof.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.104 UX ZIP/log audit and verify the public score, source trust, and exported source report in real provider output.
Continue reducing repeated assignment and rubric scaffolds until fresh provider packages have no hidden texture caveat.
